propositions: Rebar tracker operations must route through the MCP server when configured, except for local-code operations (testing, investigation, debugging, validation).

AGENTS.md must establish an umbrella policy that governs downstream guidance surfaces (docs/, templates/, .agents/rules/, packaged guides, example skills) by operation name rather than requiring per-surface rewrites.

Certified operations consist only of plan-review and completion-verifier (ADR 0049), which route through MCP and are enforceable via trusted-env registration; code review is the Gerrit LLM-Review vote, not an op-cert.
Guidance must describe certified-op enforcement as enableable but deferred, with citation to the mcp-opcert-enforcement-flip runbook, not claiming enforcement is currently live.
docs/mcp-auth.md section 7 must document the AWS deployment recipe with the ADR-named config keys (http_tls_at_edge, auth_static_tokens_file, auth_strategies) and link to the client-connection guide.

A follow-up ticket must be created to reconcile non-doc surfaces (templates/, packaged guides, .agents/rules/, example skills) via textual sweep, leaving this ticket scoped to AGENTS.md and docs only.
